title: Maison Vérane
description: Composed slowly, worn for hours. A Grasse haute perfumery landing page with an interactive twelve-hour dry-down clock and raw organ composer.
stack: Next.js 16 · Tailwind v4 · React 19 · External Store

sections.title: Header
sections.summary: sticky Calcaire bar, dynamic draining mark, nav anchors, live readout "H 03:20", appointment CTA.

sections.title: Hero
sections.summary: 16:9 full-bleed photo (`hero-flacon`), Oud shadow scrim, display headline with italic turn.

sections.title: The Dry-Down
sections.summary: pinned laboratory stage (flacon + note pyramid + scrubber + fragrance switcher).
sections.customCodeReason: Contains interactive 3D/WebGL, procedural canvas, or pinned scroll-scrubbed stage requiring an HtmlEmbed + page footer script.

sections.title: The Hours
sections.summary: four annual editions (Nº 1 Première Heure, Nº 2 Iris Calcaire, Nº 3 Fumée Lente, Nº 4 Nuit d'Oratoire) with individual notes, maceration records, and dry-down strips.

sections.title: The Organ
sections.summary: interactive three-tier raw material composer with instant formula derivation.

sections.title: The Atelier
sections.summary: four key numbers (312 raw materials, 18 mo. maceration, 400 flacons, 4 editions), three botanical plates, the Maceration Ledger table, and the Iris fields banner.

sections.title: Appointments
sections.summary: dark Oud chapter with salon protocol details, location info, and client-side validated booking form with accessible success feedback.

sections.title: Footer
sections.summary: brand colophon, anchors, Grasse legal registry.
